jobs.description:
We are Team possible – the people behind Codit, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

At Codit, we help organizations build and run digital solutions using Microsoft technology. 

We are looking for an Azure Infrastructure Architect with strong pre-sales focus to play a key role in:

• Designing, implementing, and evolving secure, scalable, and automated cloud environments for a diverse range of projects.
• Building trusted partnerships with customers, including C‑level leaders, by delivering clear, compelling technical insights and translating them into concrete solution architectures and actionable proposals. 
You’ll be a technical leader and trusted advisor with strong communication skills, combining hands-on expertise with customer-facing impact, helping Codit and our clients accelerate their cloud journeys through well-architected Azure platforms and landing zone solutions. 

Key Responsibilities 

What You’ll Do

• Lead technical pre-sales engagements (workshops, proposals, estimations, solution shaping)
• Translate customer challenges into solution architectures and commercial proposals
• Support account teams in deal positioning and closure
• Architect, design, and implement Azure platforms aligned with best practices.
• Lead the customization and modularization of Azure cloud infrastructure components to fit each client’s scale, security, and operational maturity.
• Define and enforce cloud governance, security, and compliance standards
• Automate infrastructure deployment using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Bicep, ARM, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, and business stakeholders) to deliver robust, future-proof solutions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to colleagues and contribute to internal knowledge sharing sessions.
• Stay up to date with Azure innovations, continuously improving Codit’s offerings. 

What You Bring

• Proven experience designing and deploying Azure infrastructure at scale
• Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by translating technical realities into meaningful business insights and guiding decision‑makers with authority and credibility.
• Strong knowledge of Azure core services: networking, identity management, security, monitoring, and automation.
• Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep, ARM, Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
• Experience with cloud governance, cost management, and compliance in regulated environments.
• Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, or equivalent) are highly valued.
• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch (French is a plus).
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset: you love a challenge and aren’t afraid to take initiative.
• A collaborative spirit and a sense of humor! 
Bonus Points

• Broad experience across the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (infrastructure, data, integration, and application services)
• Experience with multi-cloud, hybrid architectures or Sovereign solutions.
• Previous consulting or managed services experience.

Are you fascinated by Data?

Do you like to dig into it to find trends?

Are you looking for a rewarding and learning experience?

If so, join ACENSI as a Data Analyst!

What will you do?

• Extracting data from internal databases
• Collect, clean, structure customer data
• Analyse trends in the collected data
• Create clear and concise reports from the analysed data
• 
Enriching data sources

 

What are your skills ?

• You have experience in data processing, data analytics
• You have good knowledge of SQL, Python and PowerBI
• You have a good knowledge of Excel
• You possess a strong analytical mind
• You have good communication skills and can explain in a concise way complex information
• You speak English and French fluently. Speaking Dutch would be an asset

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!  

You are fully convinced that data science isn’t a hype, but you also believe that, in order to be valuable and really make a company smarter, it must be done right. Your goal is therefore to create the most impactful solution possible in the quickest and easiest way possible so that real value can be extracted from data and artificial intelligence.  

 

We’re looking for someone who has: 

• A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field. 
• 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience developing and implementing AI/ML models in production environments. 
• Strong Python programming skills, including experience with API-building frameworks such as FastAPI and prototyping tools like Streamlit. 
• Experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar is considered a strong asset. 
• Solid understanding of machine learning including model evaluation techniques and familiarity with advanced applications such as: NLP, forecasting, optimization, computer vision. 
• Experience in working with cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ML pipelines is a strong asset. 
• Experience with Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and large language models, is a strong asset. 
• Hands-on knowledge of vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search) for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines is a strong asset. 
• Strong communication and business analysis skills and genuinely interested in understanding the customer’s business context and challenges.
• You can explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible language to non-technical stakeholders. 
• A collaborative, open-minded mindset and a drive to keep learning in a fast-evolving field.
• 
You're fluent in Dutch or French, as well as English.

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.

• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.

• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

Profiel

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is considered an asset.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Account Manager with experience within the Flemish public sector
jobs.description:
As an Account Manager with experience within the Flemish public sector at Sopra Steria, you will play a crucial role in ensuring client retention by fostering and strengthening relationships. You’ll understand their individual needs, provide them tailored IT solutions and coordinate with internal teams to deliver the excellent service clients expect from Sopra Steria. Staying informed of industry trends, managing timelines, and answering client issues using confident communication and technical knowledge will be your day-to-day job as an Account Manager. You’re mindful of opportunities for upselling and cross-selling while building long term partnerships for community-wide digital transformation and business success.

Managing communication between the company and its clients is what our Sales colleagues do best. You’ll be an expert in how Sopra Steria delivers value. You’ll be cordial and deliver top-tier service to both internal and external clients. No one understands the needs and wants of our customers better, you’ll be able to anticipate and fulfil clients wishes with ease. Handling complex tasks without difficulty is crucial so you can hit deadlines and make sales to build a portfolio of satisfied accounts.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below:

• Experience within the Flemish public sector: In-depth understanding of the public legislative and policy landscape.
• Problem-Solving Skills: Innovative and strategic thinker.
• Commercial Expertise: Demonstrated success in business development and pitching.
• Public Affairs: Proven track record in strategic public affairs campaigns.
• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication.
• Relationship Building: Strong networking skills and an existing network.
• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• Experience: minimum 5 years’ experience
• 
Languages: Fluent in Dutch and French + excellent knowledge in English.

Responsibilities

• Strategy and Design: Define network strategy and design IT and OT architecture to meet the needs of the company
• Management and Maintenance: Oversee the company-wide IT network architecture, ensuring its stability and smooth operation
• Deployment and Supervision: Manage deployment projects and supervise wired and wireless networks
• Mobility and Remote Access: Ensure mobile connectivity and remote access to company systems for the entire group, while enabling the use of smart devices

• Proficient in network device configuration and troubleshooting
• Experience in network design, remediation, and documentation
• In-depth knowledge of Cisco and Aruba solutions
Language skills:

• Excellent command of English
• Good knowledge of French or German
Personal qualities:

• Customer-oriented
• Proactive and results-driven
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Structured, methodical, and precise work approach
• Willingness to travel up to 35% of the time

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation‑driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on‑call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).
Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.
Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

jobs.occupation: Backend Software Engineer | AI & SaaS Sector

jobs.occupation: Senior Digital Transformation Architect - Transportation sector
jobs.description:
Digital transformation is the cornerstone of Sopra Steria’s commitment to innovation and collaboration. It’s what brings businesses up to the present and secures them for the future. It’s how we align our tech and business goals to keep pace with emerging tech trends and best practices. To do so, you’ll need a forward-thinking, long-view, adaptable mindset to go with your problem solving and analytical skills. Proficiency in cloud computing, data analytics, cybersecurity, and AI skills all help us to collaborate in the business ecosystem to manage digital projects and make adoption of new tech simple and beneficial.

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problem-solving skills and commitment to continuous learning.

Small context :

From the start, you will be immersed in our company culture and way of working, understanding all the capabilities we use to serve our clients in their digital transformation journey. You will work closely with the Sopra Steria teams to provide strategic architectural guidance that helps our transportation clients navigate their transition challenges across the digital themes mentioned above.

Your role as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• You understand like no other the architectural landscape and digital challenges of our transportation customers. Moreover, you are capable and driven to help them design and implement transformative digital solutions while actively growing our advisory agency.
• You master core business processes in the transportation market and can seamlessly bridge the gap between business needs and technological solutions. You will:
• Design and architect digital transformation initiatives for railway and public transportation operators
• Lead business framing and solution architecture for key digital themes such as: Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure
• Develop enterprise architecture blueprints that align IT direction with business objectives
• Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Transportation sector, with a focus on digital transformation.
• You will be encouraged and expected to bring innovative architectural thinking, challenge the status quo, and drive growth, both with our customers and within Sopra Steria.
 

Your profile as Senior Digital Transformation Architect – Transportation "required" :

• Higher degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• 10+ years of IT architecture experience, with 5+ years in digital transformation for the Transportation sector "REQUIRED".
• Proven track record in large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes (Transformation Consulting, Cybersecurity, Data, Applications & Integrations, Cloud & Infrastructure).
• Fluent in French and English – Dutch is a plus
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in transportation.
• 
Entrepreneurial spirit with a focus on growth and business development

Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

Your role

As a Data Migration Expert (SAP), you'll be at the forefront of designing and executing data migration strategies that ensure smooth and efficient transitions across systems. Your role will be pivotal in overseeing data migration projects, from initial planning through to execution and validation. You'll ensure that data is accurately and securely transferred between systems, maintaining integrity and consistency throughout the process. Utilizing advanced tools like SAP migration cockpit and EMIGALL, you’ll streamline migration workflows and resolve any challenges that arise. If you’re passionate about orchestrating complex data migrations and want to lead in a cutting-edge environment, this position is for you.

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data migration consultant on data migration and data governance projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, data gathering, data cleansing and validation, development, testing, and execution of the migration.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions

 

Knowledge & Experience

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in executing (SAP) migration projects, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on end-to-end migration lifecycles.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and quality of the migrated data by cleansing, transforming and validating data. This requires the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, and data analysis tools such as MS Excel or Access.
• Data migration: planning, executing and managing the migration of data from legacy systems to new target environments. This involves ensuring seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, which requires proficiency in data migration tools such as S/4HANA migration cockpit, Emigall and/or LSMW. Knowledge of ETL tools as SAP Data services or Datasphere is a plus.
• Data migration planning: Strong team management skills are necessary to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams, ensuring that all members are aligned with project goals and timelines. This includes delegating tasks appropriately, providing guidance and support, fostering a collaborative work environment, and managing stakeholder expectations.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• You are a proactive, results-driven team player with strong communication skills, a customer-oriented approach, and a consultancy mindset, capable of collaborating with diverse colleagues and confidently representing Capgemini to clients.
• Resident in Belgium.
• Fluent in Dutch/French and English.
• Geographic mobility. We serve customers throughout Belgium.

Chef De Partie : Tandoor & bbq chef
